insertions.question: So let's double click on that a little bit, right. Like I'm gonna ask you the four most VC questions that every entrepreneur hates and most VCs hate and I'm not gonna ask you the way that most people say, like, what's gonna stop Zillow from doing this. Right? But - but -
No, no, but that's not my question. My question is, what happens to your company if Zillow does do this?
I don't think they'd have to pivot. I think that they would add this as an option to search for rural properties. No?
Can we go back to the business model for a second?
And have you gotten any commission to date?
What have you been doing wrong? Because you only had one sale.

But you've been doing that so far. But it doesn't seem like any of that stuff is working. You've still only got one sale. So what are you going to be doing different? And what are you going to be doing new? What are you going to be trying?
But to Mac's point, you don't get paid for all 500 leads?

So then how do you - how do you - how do you help that then? Like, cos if you're generating 500 leads, you gotta get more than one across the fence. Like, is there anything that your company can do to support the agents to help get that - like, what can you do to increase - can you just start charging for the leads? Cos like, if you're doing 500 leads, I'd rather you be charging for that than charging for the close.

Let me ask you this, what kind of people are searching? Are they actually individuals like you had described yourself? Or are they more on the commercial side of people wanting to do something with that land?

You hit upon the insurance application, which is very compelling. Obviously this would be able to inform insurance companies of the liabilities of properties. Are you thinking about licensing these capabilities to them?
You're doing 20k per month. How much have you raised so far to date?
What's your priority list right now on your product roadmap? Like what are the things that are like top of mind like these are the next two things I have to get done?
